actions.description: Hold Left: the paddle moves left for this decision
Hold Right: the paddle moves right for this decision
Hold nothing: the paddle stays where it is (also releases Space)
Press Space: start a game from the menu, or launch the resting ball at once

notes: State fields: waiting = Space is needed now (menu or gameover screen, or the ball rests on the paddle before launch); armed = Space was not held on the previous decision, so a new press will register. ball = rest / up / down / lost / none. landMs = ms until the ball is back at paddle height (wall and brick bounces simulated); landDx = landing x minus paddle centre (px, positive = right); catchNow = the paddle already covers the landing point; canReach = it can still get there in time. spotDx = signed px from the paddle centre to the planned contact position: the reachable paddle position whose bounce is predicted to break the most bricks soonest (where the ball meets the paddle sets its new direction: centre = straight up, edges = flatter); shotBricks = bricks that bounce is predicted to break. gapLeft / gapStay / gapRight = px that would remain between the paddle and the planned position after one decision of left / stay / right (walls included). Rules: 1) If waiting is true: armed true -> space; armed false -> stay (this releases Space so the next press counts). 2) Otherwise, if the three gaps are numbers: choose the action with the smallest gap (gapLeft -> left, gapStay -> stay, gapRight -> right); if two gaps tie for smallest, either of the two is fine. 3) Otherwise (loading, ball lost below the paddle, nothing to predict): stay.
